query:
-- Forfait actuel d'Enka Enka
SELECT id, residentId, totalHours, usedHours, deductedMinutes, isActive, startDate, endDate 
FROM packages 
WHERE residentId = 1 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 1;

-- Tous les pointages d'Enka Enka
SELECT id, residentId, packageId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, durationMinutes, createdAt
FROM attendances 
WHERE residentId = 1 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
